verification_targets.description: Total bounding-box extent along X: base plate length 50mm (arm is flush with the X=0 end face, so it does not extend the part).
verification_targets.notes: Base spans X = 0 to BASE_LENGTH_X (50). Arm occupies X = 0 to ARM_THICKNESS_X (5), fully inside the base footprint.

verification_targets.description: Total bounding-box extent along Y: base width 30mm, equal to the arm width (arm spans the full width of the base).
verification_targets.notes: Extrude direction of the L profile. Both base and arm span Y = 0 to BASE_WIDTH_Y (30).

verification_targets.description: Total bounding-box extent along Z: base thickness 5mm plus arm height 30mm measured above the top of the base = 35mm absolute from the bottom face (Z=0).
verification_targets.notes: ABSOLUTE value from the global Z=0 base plane. BASE_THICKNESS_Z (5) + ARM_HEIGHT_Z (30) = TOTAL_HEIGHT_Z (35). QA measures the full Z extent, not the 30mm arm-only figure.

verification_targets.description: Base plate, vertical arm and the R5 inside fillet must be fused into exactly one connected solid (one Solid in Part.solids()).
verification_targets.notes: The union of base and arm must be a boolean fuse, not two separate solids touching at a face.

verification_targets.description: Final bracket must be a closed, manifold solid with no open shells, gap seams or self-intersections (Part.is_valid() is True and volume > 0).
verification_targets.notes: Verify after the R5 fillet is applied; a failed fillet operation frequently breaks the shell.

functional_requirements: Rigid right-angle (90 degree) L-bracket: horizontal base for surface mounting/support and vertical arm for a perpendicular mounting or stop face.
5mm radius fillet on the reentrant (inside) corner reduces stress concentration under bending load at the junction of base and arm.
Base bottom face (Z=0) must be flat and planar for seating on a mounting surface.
Arm outer face (X=0) must be flat and planar and co-planar with the base end face.
No mounting holes, slots or lightening cutouts were specified - the part must be produced as a solid bracket.
Load path: bending across the filleted inside corner, so the fillet must be a true tangent-continuous blend, not a chamfer.
special_features: The vertical arm MUST be flush with the base end face at X = ARM_OUTER_FACE_X (0.0), so arm outer face and base end face lie in the same plane X = 0.
The vertical arm MUST span the full base width in Y (Y = 0 to BASE_WIDTH_Y) and MUST rise from the base to Z = TOTAL_HEIGHT_Z (35.0), i.e. ARM_HEIGHT_Z (30.0) above the base top face.

The inside/reentrant corner at (X = FILLET_AXIS_X = 5.0, Z = FILLET_AXIS_Z = 5.0) MUST carry a concave fillet of radius INSIDE_FILLET_RADIUS (5.0) that ADDS material to the corner and is tangent to both the arm inner face (X = 5) and the base top face (Z = 5).
The inside fillet MUST run the full length of the corner along the Y axis, from Y = 0 to Y = ARM_WIDTH_Y (30), as a constant-radius sweep (no variable radius, no chamfer substitute).
The bracket MUST be symmetric about the plane Y = SYMMETRY_PLANE_Y (15.0): all features mirror about the mid-width plane, and the fillet axis MUST be parallel to the Y axis.
The base and arm MUST be a single fused solid; the arm MUST NOT be modeled as a separate body merely touching the base.
All edges other than the specified inside corner MUST remain sharp (no global fillet/chamfer operation applied to the whole part).
The part MUST NOT contain any holes, slots, cutouts, ribs or embosses - none were requested and adding them would violate the specified geometry.
The primary L-shaped profile MUST be sketched in the XZ plane as a closed L polygon and extruded along +Y by ARM_WIDTH_Y (30.0), giving one single extrude before the fillet is applied.
